Class AotCacheGate

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.aotcache.AotCacheGate
public final class AotCacheGate extends Object
The verification gate of a trained cache. It passes only when every enforced check holds:
  1. Identity. The verifying JDK is the build, operating system and architecture the identity file records. A mismatch fails before any launch.
  2. Strict probes. java -XX:AOTMode=on -XX:AOTCache=app.aot -cp <jar> -version, run AotCacheSettings.verifyProbes() times. All of them run, and one failure fails the gate: some failures depend on where ASLR puts the heap.
  3. Strict smoke launch. The application launched with the cache in strict mode, through the TrainingDriver, reaches readiness and serves the workload.
  4. Coverage. From that launch's class-load log, up to the end of its workload: at least AotCacheSettings.minCoverage() of the classes come from the cache, and every io.micronaut class that does not is a lambda proxy or one the recording named as skipped because it failed verification or is a JFR event class. With AotCacheSettings.enforceCoverage() off, the numbers are only reported.
Since:

  • Method Details

    • verify

      public static AotCacheReport verify(AotCacheSettings settings, JdkProbe jdk, Path java, Path directory, String jarName, TrainingSettings training, String recordStop, BuildLogger log) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Runs the checks and writes "aot-report.json" into the directory, whether they pass or not.
      Parameters:
      settings - the cache settings; their AotCacheSettings.jvmArgs() go on every launch
      jdk - what the verifying java reported
      java - the java executable to verify with; a relative path is resolved against this JVM's working directory
      directory - the directory that holds the JAR, the cache and the identity file, and the working directory of every launch
      jarName - the JAR's file name in that directory
      training - how to reach, exercise and stop the application; its own jvmArgs are replaced by the settings'
      recordStop - how the recording ended, for the report
      log - where the checks are reported
      Returns:
      the report of a gate that passed
      Throws:
      IOException - if an enforced check fails; the message says which and why, and the report has been written
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted; every launch has been reaped by then

    • coverage

      public static AotCacheGate.Coverage coverage(List<String> classLoadLog, List<String> recordLog)
      Counts what a strict launch took from the cache.
      Parameters:
      classLoadLog - the lines of its -Xlog:class+load=info output
      recordLog - the lines of the recording's output with -Xlog:aot=info, which name the classes the recording skipped
      Returns:
      the counts
